recommendation: Feasible for a small unchanged-source Darwin client diagnostic, but not a drop-in100k–160k capacity solution under current Mac networking/FD limits. P2 is the simpler next test. Do not compile during a timed diagnostic.

source_feasibility.dependencies: HdrHistogram1.4.0 and jwt/v55.3.1; loadgen has no Linux build constraints/cgo dependency in inspected source.
portable_paths: sysstat.go gracefully returns CPU N/A when/proc/stat is absent.
Getrusage supplies process CPU; Darwin peakRSS has explicit byte-unit conversion.
run/merge networking uses standard net.Conn and accepts comma-separated host:port targets.
limits: The full search/monitor orchestration assumes Linux target/SSH shell tools; prefer external driver invoking unchanged run/merge.
Darwin whole-box CPU field is N/A; native CPU75% eligibility cannot be assumed. Preserve that fact and collect separate host/client/proxy CPU evidence.
Darwin client cannot inherit a Linux cgroup8CPU/8GiB quota; GOMAXPROCS is concurrency, not an equivalent hard CPU/memory cap.

routing_and_ports.current_blocker: Existing saved target has no published ports, so it is not reachable from native Mac through localhost. A new explicitly declared target with published loopback ports is needed.
routing_and_ports.minimal_future_mapping: One owned replacement target with16 loopback host ports33000..33015 all forwarding to the same container3000; no lo0 aliases or source changes. Preserve the exact target image/volumes/PG settings/resource budget.
routing_and_ports.native_target_argument: Comma-separated http://127.0.0.1:33000,...,:33015, distributed by unchanged parseTargets/VU logic. Distinct destination ports expand socket4-tuples just as distinct destination IPs do.
routing_and_ports.capacity_arithmetic: At the measured16,384 ephemeral ports per destination, one port cannot support100k;8 ports gives131,072 theoretical concurrent tuples and16 gives262,144 before reserved/TIME_WAIT/retries.160k needs at least10 destinations even without safety margin.
routing_and_ports.drain: Current MSL15s suggests a30s TIME_WAIT scale; keep at least the existing65s drain and verify observed closure/port headroom rather than relying on arithmetic alone.

fd_budget.known: Global file-table headroom at read is192,103; per-process kernel ceiling122,880 despite shell hard=unlimited. Use multiple native processes rather than one100k+ process.
fd_budget.proxy_estimate: Docker documents host TCP forwarding through com.docker.backend. Planning assumption: roughly one client socket FD plus one accepted proxy FD per active host connection. Under that assumption100k adds~200k Mac FDs, exceeding current~192k global headroom, and160k exceeds the per-process proxy ceiling. Actual backend FD ownership/limits must be observed before high load.
fd_budget.conclusion: A10k smoke can fit current limits with inherited soft nofile raised within the existing ceiling. A credible100k–160k run needs deliberate higher host/proxy FD limits or different direct networking/external client; none was changed.

minimal_stages.action: After P2/builds finish, pin source/module hashes and compile a new Darwin artifact from unchanged loadgen source with local Go1.27.2; record compiler/build info and new binary hash. Source remains identical, binary is not Linux886.

Root reviews an owned replacement target declaration with loopback port mappings, unchanged app+PG8CPU/16GiB/no-swap/no-affinity settings, full seed and original PG config. Do not alter the running/current container.

Run only a small5k–10k diagnostic first, normal-user native processes with explicit raised soft nofile(e.g.32768), preregistered GOMAXPROCS and exact original run/merge/workload flags. Record actual FD/env/PID/source/target/resource identities.

Collect Darwin process CPU/RSS/faults plus host CPU/memory/compression and com.docker.backend resource usage; retain native CPU N/A, lag/active/clock/error flags and incomplete work. Do not interpret missing CPU guard as passing headroom.

Attempt higher load only after the FD/ephemeral-port/proxy/headroom checks pass. Use fresh predeclared matched client configuration for both Rust and Goose; this is a new exploratory protocol, not a continuation/rescue of previous v3/P1/P2 scores.

scope: Legitimate local exploratory architecture: application/PG remain inside original shared target budget and workload source remains unchanged. It removes the generator from the Linux VM scheduler, but shares physical Mac CPU/RAM and adds a Desktop TCP proxy. It cannot establish official dedicated-x86 rank or guarantee elimination of host bottlenecks.
